mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT semester_label FROM gallery_photos
WHERE state IN ('normal', 'hidden') WHERE state = 'normal'
ORDER BY semester_label DESC
mapper.sql: g.photo_id AS photoId, g.semester_label AS semesterLabel, g.user_id AS userId, u.name AS uploaderName, g.file_url AS fileUrl, g.file_type AS fileType, g.ratio, g.title, g.hashtags AS hashtagsRaw, g.sort_order AS sortOrder, g.state, g.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM gallery_photos g LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = g.user_id
g.semester_label = #{semester}
AND g.state IN ('normal', 'hidden') AND g.state = 'normal'
AND (g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR g.hashtags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR (u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\'))
ORDER BY g.semester_label DESC, g.sort_order ASC, g.photo_id DESC
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0)
SELECT FROM gallery_photos g LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = g.user_id WHERE g.photo_id = #{photoId}
